newsitem.title: USA: New York courts propose raising their budget 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: New York courts propose raising their budget 4 pct.

text.p: New York State's courts have asked for a four percent increase in their budget percent to almost $974 million in their plan, which was due on December 1, a spokesman for the courts said on Wednesday.

David Bookstaver, press spokesamn, explained the rise was needed to keep up with a dramatic jump in caseloads, both civil and criminal, as well as to move forward with efforts to computerize the court rooms.

"I don't think it's that dramatic an increase," he said, noting that in New York City, the number of misdemeanor cases has climbed 30 to 40 percent under the Giuliani Administration's push to improve the quality of life.
A spokesman with the state budget office was not immediately available to comment.
